settings.heading: Built on Calgary roads, powered by honest service
settings.body:
TL;DR: Family-owned tire and wheel shop in Calgary since 2022, with two shops: 111 42 Ave SW and Unit 101, 3928 Edmonton Trail NE. 60+ tire brands stocked. 4.9★ from 750+ Google reviews. Same-day installation on most stocked sizes, price-matched against local independent Calgary shops.

Prince Tires started with one simple idea: Calgary drivers deserve a tire shop they can actually trust. No hidden fees, no upsells, no runaround — just straight-up expertise and fair prices on every set of tires we touch.

We've built our reputation one vehicle at a time, helping families across NE Calgary, NW Calgary, and every corner of the city stay safe through Alberta's brutal winters and everything in between. From the first October snow to spring changeover, we're ready when you need us.

Today we stock 60+ tire brands, plus wheels — including Consumer Reports Best-rated Michelin, Bridgestone, Continental, BFGoodrich, Toyo, Yokohama, Cooper, and value picks like Radar and Tesche. Every winter and all-weather tire we sell carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) symbol. Alberta has no winter-tire law, but if you drive into BC, many highways there require winter tires from October 1 (see BC's winter driving rules), and a 3PMSF tire meets them.

Run by a Calgary family. The Prince Tires team services around 70 vehicles a week across our two shops, and the NE shop at Unit 101, 3928 Edmonton Trail NE is where we do road force balancing. Most stocked sizes installed in ~45 minutes; trucks and duallies need a 60-minute slot. We process Michelin, Bridgestone, BFGoodrich, and other manufacturer warranties directly on behalf of customers.

settings.question: What tire brands does Prince Tires carry?
settings.answer: We stock 60+ tire brands across our two Calgary shops — Michelin, Bridgestone, Continental, BFGoodrich, Toyo, Yokohama, Mickey Thompson, Cooper, Firestone, Kumho, General Tire, Falken, Nexen, Dunlop, plus value picks like Radar, Tesche, Haida, and Rotalla. Wheel brands include XF Off-Road, RTX, and ENVY. See the full lineup at /pages/brands.

settings.question: How long does tire installation take?
settings.answer: Most standard tire installations take 45–60 minutes. This includes mounting, balancing, and a safety check. We offer same-day appointments and accept walk-ins based on availability — call ahead to confirm.

settings.question: Do you carry winter tires for Calgary winters?
settings.answer: Yes — winter tires are one of our specialties. We stock a wide selection of winter-rated tires suited to Calgary's climate, including studded and studless options. We recommend switching to winter tires when temperatures consistently drop below 7°C, which in Calgary is typically October through April.

settings.question: What areas do you serve?
settings.answer: We serve all of Calgary — NE, NW, SE, and SW — from two shops: 111 42 Ave SW and Unit 101, 3928 Edmonton Trail NE. All work is done in the shop, so bring your vehicle to whichever one is closer.

settings.question: Do you offer price matching?
settings.answer: Yes. If you find a lower price on the same tire from a local independent Calgary shop, bring us the quote and we'll match it. A fair price should still come with careful, honest work.

settings.question: Is an appointment required?
settings.answer: We recommend requesting a time online or by phone. Your time is set once our team confirms it by text or email. We also take walk-ins when a bay is free, and same-day or next-day times are often available.

settings.question: Who runs Prince Tires?
settings.answer: Prince Tires is a family-owned and operated tire and wheel business, founded in Calgary in 2022. We run two shops: 111 42 Ave SW in Manchester and Unit 101, 3928 Edmonton Trail NE. The team installs roughly 70 vehicles per week year-round and processes manufacturer warranty claims directly with Michelin, Bridgestone, BFGoodrich, Toyo, and other brand partners on behalf of customers.

settings.question: Does Alberta require winter tires?
settings.answer: No. Alberta has no winter-tire law, so in Calgary winter tires are your choice (most Calgary drivers run them from October to April). BC is different: many BC highways require winter tires from October 1 to April 30, and some lower routes only to March 31. Every winter and all-weather tire we sell carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) symbol, which meets the BC rule. We also stock studded and studdable options.

settings.question: Do you service trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles?
settings.answer: Yes. We service all vehicle types including sedans, crossovers, SUVs, pickup trucks, and light commercial vehicles. Let us know your vehicle year, make, and model when booking so we can confirm we have your size in stock.
